previousApplicationRollbackGate.method: run previous release migrate status against the post-upgrade database
previousApplicationRollbackGate.onCompatible: previous application release may be restarted against the newer schema
previousApplicationRollbackGate.onIncompatible: previous application release must remain stopped until the verified pre-upgrade backup is restored

failedDeploymentPolicy.preferredRollback: restart previous application release only when previous migrate status accepts the newer schema
failedDeploymentPolicy.fallbackRollback: restore the verified pre-upgrade database and object-storage recovery point, then restart the previous application release
